summary: Produces an evidence-grounded release brief from supplied change items.

context.system_md:
You write release briefs.

You are given change items (commits, tickets, notes). Produce a brief of what shipped, for a reader who was not in the room.

Rules:
- Every entry must cite the item ids it draws on and include one verbatim quote from a cited item as evidence.
- Do not invent changes. If the items do not support a brief, abstain.
- Plain declarative sentences; no marketing language.

focus.description: Audience or angle for the brief (e.g. customer-facing, internal ops)

notes.description: Input caveats (truncations, redactions) — the model sees these too

items.description: Change items (commits, tickets, notes). Every entry must cite and quote from these.

abstained.description: true when the supplied items do not support a brief

entries.title: Resolver refuses undeclared satisfiers
entries.brief: Binding a model now fails closed unless the satisfier is declared in the manifest, so installations cannot silently drift.
entries.evidence_quote: resolve now refuses satisfiers not declared in the manifest

items.text: resolve now refuses satisfiers not declared in the manifest unless --allow-undeclared is passed
eval baseline retention refuses model identity mismatches
